Context: manual acceptance item of tuh-01M26H99QVANVJCXR9FM2Z8Q7X (versioned state): after a claim via the MCP shim, GitHub's backlog.md must show the task in progress within one sync interval (60s). This task exists only to be claimed and observed against a daemon running the branch build; it is claimed, measured, and finished by a probe script speaking the shim from a scratch clone.

The ask: claim this task through the shim of a daemon built from branch tuh-01M26H99QVANVJCXR9FM2Z8Q7X/versioned-state, then poll GitHub's rendered backlog.md on the tuhdoo data branch until this task appears under In progress; record the elapsed time.

Acceptance: the elapsed claim-to-GitHub time is recorded in this task's finish_run summary and cited in the PR for tuh-01M26H99QVANVJCXR9FM2Z8Q7X.

Constraints: no code changes; nothing else.
